headline: NatWest Faces Union Backlash Over Mandated Return to Office
summary: NatWest is facing criticism from a union over plans requiring workers to attend the office at least two days a week starting in February.
why: NatWest Group is a major UK banking and financial services institution.

impacts.name: NatWest Group
impacts.why: Mandated office returns can create labor friction and union disputes, potentially affecting operational continuity.
